title: Gotrade Daily: TSMC Beats as Hot CPI Lifts Rate-Hike Bets
summary: TSMC beat third-quarter profit estimates as a hot US inflation print revived rate-hike worries. Here is what to watch in tonight's US session.
body_markdown:
Markets raised the odds of a further Fed rate hike at the October 27-28 meeting, though those odds later eased as Fed officials signaled they could wait for a clearer picture of inflation ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-fall-as-hot-inflation-revives-fed-hike-concerns-4950317) ).


### PPI and retail sales tonight


Producer prices ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/ppi.htm) ) and retail sales ([Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/retail/release_schedule.html) ) are due tonight. Either report could firm up or ease rate-hike expectations after the CPI data.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


Late Wednesday US time, S&P 500 futures were down 0.3% at 7,747.50 and Nasdaq 100 futures fell 0.8% to 29,943. Dow futures were flat at 51,866. AI infrastructure names took the heaviest hits on Wednesday: **CoreWeave** ([CRWV](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/crwv/) ) fell 16%, **Nebius** ([NBIS](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nbis/) ) and **Dell** ([DELL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/dell/) ) each lost 11%, and **Oracle** ([ORCL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/orcl/) ) dropped 9% ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-fall-as-hot-inflation-revives-fed-hike-concerns-4950317) ).


## Macro Note 📝


Treasury yields jumped after the CPI report. Brent crude is holding above $105 a barrel ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-fall-as-hot-inflation-revives-fed-hike-concerns-4950317) ), while Yemen's Houthis vowed more attacks on Saudi Aramco oil facilities ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/yemens-houthis-vow-more-attacks-on-saudi-airports-oil-facilities-after-aramco-hq-hit-4949648) ).


## Conclusion


TSMC's results point to AI chip demand that is still strong, but the market is weighing the risk of higher rates. Tonight's PPI and retail sales data are the next clues on the Fed's path.


How chip and AI infrastructure stocks respond tonight may show which of those forces weighs more.
